# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not publish exploitable security details, credentials, tokens, or private user data in a public issue.

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option on the repository's Security tab, if it is available. Include the affected component, impact, reproduction steps, and any safe proof of concept.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact the repository maintainers through their GitHub profile before sharing exploit details publicly.

## Scope

Please report issues that could affect user data, account/session security, unsafe handling of external content, or the integrity of the application. Do not include real secrets or personal data in reports.
